title: Your first trade for Wednesday, December 12
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of Target .
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Home Depot .
Dan Nathan was a seller of Coca-Cola .
Guy Adami was a buyer of CME Group .
